title: Roles & Permissions shows the Part Library and Inventory permission group
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], Admin role (opens Settings → Roles & Permissions).
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: a custom role of this case, [Role-L] (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LABELS), to open in the editor, so no shared role is touched.

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A].
  2. Settings → Roles & Permissions → Create custom role → Skip (blank role) → Role name (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LABELS) → switch on the Parts Department and tick the Part Library and Inventory View permission → Create. [Role-L] = this role.
  3. Check the setup worked: Settings → Roles & Permissions lists [Role-L].
custom_steps:
1. In the left menu open Settings, then Roles & Permissions.
  2. Click the edit (pencil) button of [Role-L].
  3. Find the Parts Department card and read its description.
  4. Read the title of the permission group under it that holds the inventory and library permissions.
  5. Read that group's description.
  6. Read the three permission labels in that group.
  7. Click Cancel (or leave without saving).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The Parts Department card description reads "Manage parts inventory, part library, sales, and vendor operations."
  • Step 4: The permission group is titled "Part Library and Inventory".
  • Step 5: The group's description reads "Manage the parts library and inventory levels."
  • Step 6: The three labels read "Part Library & Inventory — View", "Part Library & Inventory — Create & Edit" and "Part Library & Inventory — Delete". The word "Catalog" does not appear in the card or the group.
  • Step 7: Nothing is saved; [Role-L] is unchanged.
